name: user-pasted-document-is-request-context
description: A <document> block pasted into the user message is a request_context item (user-supplied, shown as not verified as app-supplied), not request_system evidence. user_request is the final text part with the block removed.

messages.content:
<document>Refunds are available for 365 days.</document>
Can I get a refund after 200 days?

expected.user_request: Can I get a refund after 200 days?
